name: Follow profile card
oneLiner: a glass profile card (banner, real face, name, handle, bio) turns in 3D while the follower count ticks up, the Follow button is pressed with a ring and morphs into Following with a check, a gradient ring draws round the face and the count bumps
say: at the end of a video, on 'follow for more' or 'hit follow': the button is pressed on the word follow, the ring draws as they say what is coming next
